items.title: Sands interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: [(boilerplate)] Christian was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 2, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Christian was interviewed in Clinton, New York on February 2, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m very pleased to have Christian Sands here this evening.
